summary.problem: The nightly release workflow failed during the 'Publish Release' step with 'npm error No workspaces found: --workspace='.
summary.root_cause: In .github/workflows/release-nightly.yml, package names are passed to .github/actions/publish-release using repository variables (vars.CLI_PACKAGE_NAME, vars.CORE_PACKAGE_NAME, vars.A2A_PACKAGE_NAME). When executing scheduled nightly releases in the 'internal' environment where these variables are not defined, the inputs evaluate to empty strings, causing 'npm publish --workspace=' to fail.
summary.context: The publish-release action requires cli-package-name, core-package-name, and a2a-package-name inputs but does not define default values for them. Providing default fallback values ('@google/gemini-cli', '@google/gemini-cli-core', '@google/gemini-cli-a2a-server') ensures the publish action succeeds even when environment repository variables are omitted or empty.

steps: Add default values for cli-package-name ('@google/gemini-cli'), core-package-name ('@google/gemini-cli-core'), and a2a-package-name ('@google/gemini-cli-a2a-server') in .github/actions/publish-release/action.yml.

Add default values for cli-package-name ('@google/gemini-cli'), core-package-name ('@google/gemini-cli-core'), and a2a-package-name ('@google/gemini-cli-a2a-server') in .github/actions/tag-npm-release/action.yml.
Update .github/workflows/release-nightly.yml to use fallback expressions for package name parameters (e.g. ${{ vars.CLI_PACKAGE_NAME || '@google/gemini-cli' }}) when calling publish-release.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The nightly release workflow successfully resolves package names when executing in the internal environment and publishes packages without empty workspace flags.
verification_steps: Trigger a dry-run of the release-nightly.yml workflow via workflow_dispatch.
Verify that the Publish Release step resolves cli-package-name, core-package-name, and a2a-package-name correctly without producing --workspace=.
